question: does supervised training beat zero-shot on GRB2 fitness?

test_set.definition: held-out positions with no position seen in training

conclusion: On genuinely novel positions neither supervised model is distinguishable from zero-shot ESM-2 scoring. The +0.045 seen on the headline test set came from position leakage: 82% of those variants share a partner position with training. The fitness-only specialist is best on the leaky metric and worst on the clean one, which is the signature of fitting position identity.
method: 2000 paired bootstrap resamples of the 1220 test variants
